scope: Source-only independent art/alpha gate. Runtime unchanged; no phone operations. All three candidate WebPs and original cast sheets viewed; generation metadata read and conversion equality independently reproduced.
qualityClaim: Source candidate gate only; no commercial or phone acceptance.

measurement.method: Pillow RGBA + NumPy. Compared full decoded candidate array to generation PNG array. Inspected all four edges of each 543x241 partition, plus outer row723 and adjacent internal boundary rows/columns. Alpha mass is sum(alpha)/255.
measurement.nonDivisibleHeightNote: 724 is not divisible by 3; fractional source-row stepping requires existing renderer behavior. This is recorded, not independently treated as a visual failure, because boundary-adjacent pixels remain below alpha8.

sequence.assessment: Frame7 crisp stars align with intended hit; strong growth and declining tail exist, though frame12 still has three visible shapes.

statuses.identity: Original includes recognizably clenched wind fists and rapid directional multi-hit strikes. Candidate replaces them with three broad leafy spirals; fist silhouettes and directional fist barrage are absent. Shape family becomes close to stormCircle. This is a concrete loss of skill identity, not a padding or style preference.
statuses.minimumNext: Preserve three separate wide sites but restore readable wind fist silhouettes / repeated strike motion. Do not compensate with group scale or geometry.

sequence.assessment: Three tilted circular wind sites grow, show sharp frame7 contact stars and taper to small rings by frame12. Circular/open-core wind motif remains.

statuses.identity: Circular jade/white slicing rings and swirling wind remain recognizable as circular wind formation. More horizontal composition is compatible with wide target row.
usbChecks: At actual fitted size, verify three target sites remain distinguishable and ring details do not become generic green pads.
Inspect peak frames5-8 for actor/HUD obstruction and final tail for hard pop.
Do not enlarge group geometry to force source width.

alpha.gridFinding: Faint red grid has real low-alpha residue, not alpha>=8 line. Internal column1086 max alpha5 median2; neighbouring grid rows/columns max1-3. Do not call it an opaque/background grid or reject solely from the black-preview appearance.

sequence.assessment: Growth and tail fade exist; bright contact star is already present at all three points in frame1 and persists throughout, weakening frame7/8 hit contrast. End remains three similar flame silhouettes, smaller/dimmer rather than ember breakup.

statuses.identity: Original has multiple sharp fire blades, crossed slashes and a later explosive release. Candidate reduces the action to three generic upright flame tongues with bottom stars. Repeated/crossed slash identity is lost; fire element alone is insufficient to preserve this skill.
statuses.minimumNext: Keep separated three attack sites but recover sharp fire-blade / crossed-strike buildup and a concentrated hit burst, then ember breakup. Do not restore an opaque all-row explosion or alter geometry.

doNotRejectFor: Failure to meet an arbitrary prompt 6% margin
Black-background preview showing alpha1-5 red residue as if opaque
stopRefinement: stormCircle source static polish: retain candidate pending focused USB; reopen only on concrete phone failure
